big_case.notes: A private criminal defendant's application to stay a Sixth Circuit order revoking pretrial release, linked to a cert petition (26-391) on the standard of appellate review of Bail Reform Act detention decisions. The underlying split has broad reach across federal detention practice and the speech-adjacent facts drew press attention, but the application itself disposes only of interim release for one defendant ahead of a near-term trial, and the Court denied it without noted dissent.
